codes.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many failed attempts – try again in a few minutes.
codes.PASSWORD_LOGIN_DISABLED: Password sign-in is disabled – please use single sign-on.
codes.SSO_VAULT_LOCKED: Single sign-on is not available until an administrator unlocks the vault.
codes.SAME_PASSWORD: Choose a password different from the current one.
codes.PASSWORD_POLICY: The password needs at least 10 characters, with letters and at least one digit or symbol.

codes.SAME_PASSPHRASE: Choose a passphrase different from the current one.

codes.PDF_NO_SIGNATURE: The file starts with a PDF generated for this record, but no signature was added.

codes.TICKET_SOURCE_UNKNOWN: Unknown source – an administrator manages the sources.
codes.TICKET_RESPONSIBLE_UNKNOWN: A responsible user or team does not exist.
codes.TICKET_DUPLICATE: A ticket reference with this source and number exists already.
codes.TICKET_OPENED_IN_FUTURE: The opening date cannot be in the future.
codes.TICKET_RESOLVED_BEFORE_OPENED: The ticket cannot be resolved before it was opened.
codes.TICKET_CREATE_FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to add ticket references.
codes.TICKET_EDIT_FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to change this ticket reference.
codes.TICKET_DELETE_ADMIN_ONLY: Only administrators can delete ticket references.
codes.TICKET_CHANGED: Someone changed this ticket reference in the meantime. Reload the page and apply your changes again.
